plain_english_revision: This amendment adds a new subsection stating that the state of Alabama is responsible for covering all reasonable costs to raise any child born after this amendment's ratification, provided the birth mother certifies she would have otherwise aborted the unborn child.
candidate_position_supported: The candidate position supported by this amendment is that the state should assume financial responsibility for raising children born to mothers who certify they would have otherwise aborted them.
evidence_quotes: (d) This state further acknowledges, declares, and affirms that it is the public policy of this state that the state be responsible for all reasonable costs of raising the child to the age of majority
